Braised Brisket

Served at: Hanukkah (Festival of Lights)

Serves 6 to 8Prep 20 minCook 3 hours

Braised brisket is a classic Jewish dish often served during Hanukkah, the Festival of Lights. This tender, flavorful meat symbolizes warmth and family gathering during the holiday, complementing the celebratory lighting of the menorah.

Ingredients

  • 4 pounds (1.8 kg) beef brisket
  • 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
  • 2 large onions, sliced
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 cups (480 ml) beef broth
  • 1 cup (240 ml) dry red wine
  • 1/2 cup (120 ml) tomato sauce
  • 2 tablespoons brown sugar
  • 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
  • 2 teaspoons paprika
  • 1 teaspoon dried thyme
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
  • 3 large carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
  • 3 stalks celery, cut into chunks
  • 2 bay leaves

Method

  1. Preheat the oven to 325°F (163°C).
  2. Pat the brisket dry and season with salt, pepper, and paprika on all sides.
  3. Heat vegetable oil in a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
  4. Sear the brisket on all sides until browned, about 4-5 minutes per side; remove and set aside.
  5. Add sliced onions and garlic to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
  6. Pour in the beef broth, red wine, and tomato sauce, stirring to combine.
  7. Stir in brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, dried thyme, and bay leaves.
  8. Return the brisket to the pot, nestling it into the liquid.
  9. Add carrots and celery around the brisket.
  10. Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
  11. Bake for about 3 hours, or until the brisket is fork-tender.
  12. Remove the pot from the oven and let the brisket rest for 15 minutes before slicing against the grain.
  13. Serve the brisket with the braised vegetables and sauce spooned over the top.

Tips

  • For extra flavor, marinate the brisket overnight in the broth mixture before cooking.
  • Use a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven to ensure even cooking and prevent burning.
  • Leftover brisket makes excellent sandwiches or can be reheated with additional sauce.
